headline: VYJUVEK demand drives another quarter of growth
summary_short: Krystal Biotech reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $119.2 million, up 24.1% y/y, with net income of $54.8 million (+42.9% y/y) and diluted EPS of $1.79.
summary_long: Global VYJUVEK net product revenue was $119.2 million, up 24% year-over-year, on durable U.S. demand (over 730 reimbursement approvals, 640+ prescribers) and growing international uptake in Germany, France, and Japan. Gross margin was 95%. R&D expense was roughly flat at $14.5 million; SG&A rose to $39.9 million from $35.1 million. Net income grew 42.9% y/y to $54.8 million, or $1.85/share basic and $1.79/share diluted. The company guided full-year 2026 non-GAAP combined R&D and SG&A expense (excluding stock-based compensation) to $175.0-$195.0 million.

drivers.explanation: Growth was driven by durable U.S. VYJUVEK demand (730+ reimbursement approvals, 640+ prescribers) and growing international launches in Germany, France, and Japan.
